title: Candidate Dashboard Real MariaDB Metrics Aggregation & Multi-Step Onboarding
spec:
### 1. MANDATE & PROBLEM STATEMENT
src/services/api/platform.js:1898 defines getStatesOfUser as a hardcoded stub returning [].
Consequently, candidate counters for resumes, cover letters, and applications show 0 despite existing records.
Furthermore, the candidate onboarding checklist contains only 1 single hardcoded step.

### 2. ARCHITECTURAL SPECIFICATION
1. Author GET /api/user-stats in backend aggregating user document counts (resumes, covers, portfolios, applications).
2. Connect getStatesOfUser to call /api/user-stats.
3. Update DashboardHomepage.jsx and CubaCandidateHero.jsx to render honest metrics.
4. Expand candidate onboarding checklist to track completion of Profile, First Resume, Cover Letter, and First Job Application.

### 3. IMPLEMENTATION PLAN
- S1: Author GET /api/user-stats in backend/routes/platform.js.
- S2: Connect getStatesOfUser in src/services/api/platform.js.
- S3: Update DashboardHomepage.jsx to consume live stats.
- S4: Update CubaCandidateHero.jsx to reflect live stats.
- S5: Expand onboarding checklist.
- S6: Author test suite tests/dir058-dashboard-stats.test.mjs.

plan.summary: DIR-058 PLAN (P1). TARGET CHECK + PROVEN DEFECTS (read-only, zero code changed; every finding cites file:line). (1) src/services/api/platform.js:1898 getStatesOfUser(_userId) is a hardcoded stub that returns [] - NOT a stats object. Its two consumers can therefore never show a real number: DashboardHomepage.jsx:287 does stats.documentsGenerated || 0 so it is permanently 0, and DashboardActions.jsx:32 spreads the array ({...[]} = {}) so documentsGenerated/Downloaded are undefined and the dashboard action counters render 0 forever. (2) DashboardHomepage.jsx:74-89 onboardingSteps is a hardcoded array of EXACTLY ONE step (id 1, Create your first resume, completed:false, score:15) with no derivation from real data, so the checklist can never reflect actual progress. (3) CubaCandidateHero.jsx:238-246 renders a card LABELLED Job Applications but feeds it getTrackedJobs() (job_tracker rows) - a mislabel - and the hero carries no cover-letter, portfolio or application metric at all. AVAILABLE BUILDING BLOCKS: the repository exposes getResumes(uid), getCovers(uid), getPortfolios(uid) and getApplications(filters); backend/routes/platform.js already imports requireAuth and applies router.use(requireAuth) at line 261; backend/routes/miscData.js /stats is the established response shape ({success, stats, source}). PLAN: S1 author GET /api/user-stats in backend/routes/platform.js (owner-scoped via req.user.uid) returning honest counts {resumes, covers, portfolios, applications, trackedJobs} plus the existing generated/downloaded/visited counters, and a real 503 on read failure - never fabricated zeros; S2 make getStatesOfUser call /api/user-stats and return that object while keeping the legacy array-spread consumer working; S3 DashboardHomepage consumes the live stats; S4 CubaCandidateHero uses the live APPLICATION count for the Job Applications card (fixing the tracked-jobs mislabel) and adds cover-letter/portfolio metrics; S5 expand onboardingSteps to the four mandated steps (Profile, First Resume, Cover Letter, First Job Application) with completion DERIVED from the real counts; S6 author tests/dir058-dashboard-stats.test.mjs. Constraints: zero schema change, no frozen module touched, owner-scoped (no cross-user leakage), honest failure states. Awaiting your GREEN SIGNAL before ACT.
steps: S1: author owner-scoped GET /api/user-stats in backend/routes/platform.js aggregating resumes/covers/portfolios/applications plus the existing generated/downloaded/visited counters via the repository, returning {success, stats, source} and a real 503 on failure
S2: connect getStatesOfUser in src/services/api/platform.js to /api/user-stats, returning the stats object while keeping the legacy array-spread consumer working
S3: update DashboardHomepage.jsx to consume the live stats and derive onboarding completion from them
S4: update CubaCandidateHero.jsx to show the real application count for the Job Applications card (fixing the getTrackedJobs mislabel) and add cover-letter and portfolio metrics
S5: expand onboardingSteps to Profile, First Resume, Cover Letter and First Job Application with completion derived from the real counts
S6: author tests/dir058-dashboard-stats.test.mjs (backend route contract + client wiring + onboarding derivation + no-fabricated-zero assertions)
S7: run lint, build and the product matrix, then submit evidence

evidence.summary: DIR-058 COMPLETE (S1-S6). PROVEN DEFECTS FIXED: (1) platform.js:1898 getStatesOfUser was a hardcoded return [] so every dashboard counter was pinned at 0 (DashboardHomepage.jsx:287 and DashboardActions.jsx:32 spread/Access it); it now reads the real owner-scoped endpoint and returns apiError (never fabricated zeros) on failure. (2) DashboardHomepage.jsx:74-89 onboardingSteps held exactly ONE hardcoded step; it now has the four mandated steps (Profile, First Resume, Cover Letter, First Job Application) with completion DERIVED from measured counts via applyOnboardingProgress. (3) CubaCandidateHero.jsx:238-246 labelled a card Job Applications but fed it getTrackedJobs() - a mislabel - it now shows the REAL application count with tracked jobs moved to the hint. NEW ENDPOINT: GET /api/user-stats - owner-scoped via req.user.uid, aggregating getResumes/getCovers/getPortfolios/getApplications({applicantId})/getTrackedJobs plus derived profileComplete, returning {success, stats, source} and a real 503 on failure. LIVE PROOF (.bridge/evidence/dir058-live-probe.log): ANON 401 AUTH_REQUIRED; AUTHED 200 success=true source=MARIADB_USER_DOCUMENTS with numeric stats and boolean profileComplete. DOCUMENTED DEVIATION: the directive named backend/routes/platform.js, but that router is mounted at /api/platform (index.js:510) so it returned 404 for the specified /api/user-stats path (proven by probe, then removed); the handler lives in backend/routes/miscData.js which is mounted at /api (index.js:511) alongside /stats and /favourites. GATES: new suite 5/5; dashboard+Cuba regression 67/67; backend routes.integration 24 pass/0 fail; product matrix 756 pass/0 fail; eslint 0 errors; build exit 0 in 2.35s. Doc: .bridge/evidence/dir058-implementation-evidence.md.
